bronze_male.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Basketball athlete for the Bronze tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: dark brown skin, short coiled black hair, brown eyes. Visibly junior athlete, approximately 12–14, natural youthful face and proportions, modest practical kit; no adult musculature or jewellery. Collection palette: charcoal and white foundations; burgundy/gold competition kit; deep black/gold final kit. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Basic junior charcoal jersey and shorts, plain basketball shoes. Equipment: One textured orange basketball, sleeveless basketball jersey, appropriate shorts and basketball shoes. Both variants use equally functional kit. Award: None. Pose: Standing relaxed with one basketball held against the hip. Tier silhouette direction: Relaxed introductory three-quarter view; natural asymmetrical weight distribution and curious expression. Establish the junior identity without a stiff catalogue stance. Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.

Sport-specific constraints: Use original basketball trophy and ring designs; no NBA/WNBA team marks or copied league trophies. Equal championship status for both variants. A ring can support the story but must not be the only visible change at thumbnail size.

Functional plain charcoal sleeveless jersey/shorts with thin white seams, plain high-top basketball shoes and short white socks. ONE textured orange basketball held at hip; free hand relaxed, asymmetrical three-quarter stance, no awards or accessories. Natural junior anatomy, no chibi.
